goal: Add a "Comparar Benchmarks" button on the model settings screen that opens a dialog comparing AA and OpenRouter data with per-field import
architectureSummary: New backend endpoint aggregates data from 3 sources (AA benchmarks DB, OpenRouter benchmarks DB, OpenRouter Models API) into a normalized comparison response. Frontend dialog renders a side-by-side table with per-field import buttons that update the local form state.
globalConstraints: Feature isolation: new code in apps/web/src/features/models/, never imports from other features
No new dependencies without explicit approval

steps.title: Add OpenRouterModelData type
steps.description: Add OpenRouterModelData interface to packages/contracts/src/benchmarks.ts with fields: id, name, context_length, max_output_tokens, capabilities (supports_vision, supports_tools), pricing (prompt, completion per 1M tokens), family, description
steps.command: Edit packages/contracts/src/benchmarks.ts to add the new type
steps.codeExample: export interface OpenRouterModelData { id: string; name: string; context_length: number | null; max_output_tokens: number | null; capabilities: { supports_vision: boolean; supports_tools: boolean } | null; pricing: { prompt: string; completion: string } | null; family: string | null; description: string | null; }

steps.title: Create OpenRouter models API fetcher
steps.description: Create a function that calls GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models, parses the response, and returns typed model data for the requested model
steps.command: Create a new service file or add to existing service that exports fetchOpenRouterModelData(modelName: string): Promise<OpenRouterModelData | null>
steps.expectedResult: Function returns OpenRouterModelData or null on error
steps.codeExample: export async function fetchOpenRouterModelData(modelName: string): Promise<OpenRouterModelData | null> { try { const res = await fetch(https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models); const json = await res.json(); const model = json.data?.find((m: any) => m.id?.includes(modelName) || m.name?.toLowerCase() === modelName.toLowerCase()); return model ? mapToOpenRouterModelData(model) : null; } catch { return null; } }

tasks.title: Benchmark comparison endpoint

acceptanceCriteria: GET /models/:name/benchmark-comparison returns 200 with valid JSON
Response matches BenchmarkComparisonResponse type
AA data sourced from model_proxy_benchmarks or JSON fallback
OpenRouter benchmarks sourced from model_proxy_benchmarks or JSON fallback
OpenRouter Models API called on-demand via fetchOpenRouterModelData
Alias matching works correctly
Edge cases: no match returns empty fields, API errors handled gracefully
rules: Use existing benchmark repository for DB queries

steps.title: Add BenchmarkComparisonResponse types to contracts
steps.description: Add BenchmarkComparisonField and BenchmarkComparisonResponse interfaces to packages/contracts/src/benchmarks.ts
steps.codeExample: export interface BenchmarkComparisonField { key: string; label: string; currentValue: string | number | boolean | null; aa: { value: string | number | boolean | null; source: string; sourceLabel: string } | null; openrouter: { value: string | number | boolean | null; source: string; sourceLabel: string } | null; } export interface BenchmarkComparisonResponse { modelName: string; matchedAaModel: string | null; matchedOpenRouterModel: string | null; fields: BenchmarkComparisonField[]; }

steps.title: Register GET /models/:name/benchmark-comparison route
steps.description: Add route handler in model-routes.ts that: 1) resolves model name via aliases, 2) queries AA benchmarks, 3) queries OpenRouter benchmarks, 4) calls fetchOpenRouterModelData, 5) builds comparison fields array, 6) returns response
steps.codeExample: app.get(/models/:name/benchmark-comparison, async (req, res) => { try { const { name } = req.params; const aliases = await loadAliases(); const resolvedName = aliases[name] || name; const aaModel = await findBenchmarkModel(resolvedName, artificial-analysis); const orModel = await findBenchmarkModel(resolvedName, openrouter); const orModelData = await fetchOpenRouterModelData(resolvedName); const fields = buildComparisonFields(aaModel, orModel, orModelData, currentConfig); res.json({ modelName: name, matchedAaModel: aaModel?.name || null, matchedOpenRouterModel: orModel?.id || null, fields }); } catch (error) { res.status(500).json({ error: String(error) }); } });

tasks.title: useBenchmarkComparison hook + API client
tasks.description: Add fetchBenchmarkComparison to the API client and create a React Query hook that fetches comparison data for a model.
acceptanceCriteria: fetchBenchmarkComparison calls GET /models/:name/benchmark-comparison
useBenchmarkComparison hook uses useQuery with correct key
Hook returns typed data, loading, and error states
Query is disabled when modelName is empty

steps.title: Add fetchBenchmarkComparison to API client
steps.description: Add fetchBenchmarkComparison(modelName: string) function to apps/web/src/shared/lib/api-client/models.ts that calls GET /models/:name/benchmark-comparison via fetchApi
steps.codeExample: export async function fetchBenchmarkComparison(modelName: string): Promise<BenchmarkComparisonResponse> { return fetchApi<BenchmarkComparisonResponse>(`/models/${encodeURIComponent(modelName)}/benchmark-comparison`); }

steps.title: Create useBenchmarkComparison hook
steps.description: Create apps/web/src/features/models/hooks/use-benchmark-comparison.ts with a useQuery hook that calls fetchBenchmarkComparison
steps.codeExample: export function useBenchmarkComparison(modelName: string) { return useQuery({ queryKey: [benchmark-comparison, modelName], queryFn: () => fetchBenchmarkComparison(modelName), enabled: !!modelName, staleTime: 0, }); }
